message.content:
It’s a surprisingly quick operation – the whole tower is usually repainted in roughly **two weeks**.  

Here’s why:

| Factor | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| Height | 324 m (1,063 ft) |
| Surface area | ~10,000 m² (≈107,000 ft²) |
| Frequency | Every 7 years (to protect against rust) |
| Crew | 30–40 skilled painters working in shifts |
| Method | Rope‑access and temporary scaffolding; spray‑painting from the ground and from the top |
| Time | About 14 days of continuous work (weather permitting) |

So while the tower itself is massive, the painting crew’s organization and modern equipment mean the job can be wrapped up in just a couple of weeks.
